revise.summary: Revised content/lessons/10-code-review.md and nothing else; both gates pass (lint clean at 2,824 words, content test 14 passed). The Site story now holds only repo facts: the old Lessons (d21fc2c 07-code-review.md and 11-main-flow.md), the placeholder Lesson at 8e2ff32 and the bodies of PR #7 and PR #9. I cut the claims only a session log could back: that the agent used a fixed point it had suggested earlier, curl, the Shotgun Surgery label, the 39 minutes, the "15 problems, 10 worth fixing" bug hunt, and the "13 findings". The chat Scene drops its invented counts, says its summary line is illustrative, and no longer contradicts the Site story. Skill facts were rechecked against the 1.3.1 SKILL.md files. The Built-in /code-review is now "ships with Claude Code, not with Matt's Skills". /implement and /implement-spec are noted as calling the bare name, the tooling skip applies to Standards only, and the report outline is hedged. The 36-vs-18 figures are cited to Discussion #1091, which I confirmed through the GitHub API. The Try block now has a plan-mode check, a /clear before the reviews, and what you'll see at each step. In the Final test, the one-ticket contradiction is fixed and scenario-no-spec is replaced by predict-departures-order, so goal 3's Spec sorting is tested. scenario-wrong-feature becomes predict-wrong-feature, and why-two-reviewers and scenario-bug-hunt now test transfer. Checkpoint right answers are no longer the shortest option.

The stem also holds a second mistake the Lesson teaches: she re-runs the review straight away in the session that made the fixes (line 214, "Review from a clean session"). So a spot- question meant to have one mistake has two. And the right option is the only one that isn't a "should have / needed to" remedy, which is a wording tell.
quiz.evidence: Line 397: "...again, without committing." Line 400: "- [x] She reviewed before committing the fixes." Line 214: "Review after `/clear` ... or in a new session." The wrong options at lines 398, 402 and 404 all say "should have" or "needed to". docs/engineering/code-review.md:81 (1.3.1 plugin) backs the key: the review "excludes staged and working-tree changes".
quiz.fix:
Replace the block with:
